in_arabic.name: حِليل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعود إلى العصر الجاهلي، ويعني المطيع للّه، والمحافظ على العادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: يرجع اسم حِليل إلى العصر الجاهلي، حيث كان أحد أسماء قبيلة بني الحارثة، ويعني المطيع للّه، والمحافظ على العادة، كما يُعد اسمًا من أسماء الصالحين، ويُستخدم في الإسلام للوصف الشخصي، والوصف الاجتماعي، ويُعد من أسماء الصالحين، الذين أُذكروا في القرآن الكريم، ويُعتبر اسمًا مرغوبًا في الإسلام، نظرًا لروحه الإسلامية، والخلفية الثقافية التي يرتكز عليها

in_urdu.name: حِلیل
in_urdu.meaning: اسم جوہری ہے جو عرب دنیا میں قدیم زمانے سے استعمال ہو رہا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کے فرمانبردار، اور عادت پر اترنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حِلیل کے معنی اللہ تعالیٰ کے فرمانبردار اور عادت پر اترنا ہیں، جو عرب دنیا میں قدیم زمانے سے استعمال ہو رہے ہیں۔ اس کا لفظی معنی ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی مرضی پر عمل کرنا اور اپنی عادت پر اترنا۔ اس کے بعد اس کا استعمال بہت زیادہ ہوا ہے اور یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हिलील
in_hindi.meaning: यदि हाल ही में बना नाम है, तो इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह का पालनकर्ता, और मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिलील नाम का अर्थ है अल्लाह का पालनकर्ता और मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका उपयोग बच्चों के नामकरण के लिए किया जाता है। इसके अलावा, यह नाम मुस्लिम परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति के नाम से भी जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_english.name: Hilel
in_english.meaning: The name Hilel refers to a person who follows Allah's will and adheres to the divine commands
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hilel is derived from the Arabic root 'h-l-l,' which means to follow or obey. In the context of Islam, Hilel refers to a person who follows Allah's will and adheres to the divine commands. This name is significant in Islamic tradition, as it reflects the importance of obedience to Allah's will and the pursuit of righteousness. Hilel is also mentioned in the Quran as the name of a righteous person who was known for his piety and devotion to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hilel doesn't hold a significant cultural impact or recognition in the Islamic world, as it is not commonly used among Muslims. However, in Jewish culture, Hilel is a well-known name, particularly for those familiar with the Talmud and the stories of Hillel the Elder and Hillel the Younger. Hillel the Elder, a famous scholar, is renowned for his wisdom, humility, and compassion toward non-Jews, embodying important moral values.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hilel signifies commitment to the divine revelation of truth. In this context, the name is a daily reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding. It's an encouragement to explore and expand our awareness of the world around us, recognizing that the ultimate truth lies with Allah (SWT). The name also symbolizes the refusal of falsehood and the unwavering pursuit of authenticity and truthfulness.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hisham's Sirat Rasul Allah (Life of the Prophet), narrating the story of Prophet Solomon (Sulayman) and the Queen of Sheba (Bilqis), where Hilel is mentioned as a wise man who advised Queen Bilqis to embrace Islam, and her son, Yemenite King Tarik, who was a follower of Prophet Solomon's religion. This story is believed to have occurred around 10th century BCE.
historical_references.context: Prophet Solomon's interaction with Queen Bilqis of Sheba and her son Tarik, where Hilel is mentioned as a wise man who advised Queen Bilqis to embrace Islam.

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa'l-Muluk (History of Prophets and Kings), describing Hilel as a prophet mentioned in the Torah (Jewish holy book) and mentioned as a contemporary of Prophet Elijah. This reference is believed to have occurred around 9th century CE.
historical_references.context: Mention of Hilel as a prophet in Al-Tabari's historical work, who is also mentioned in the Torah.
